City of Chicago
                                                                   O2021-3968
                            Office of the City Clerk
                           Document Tracking Sheet



Meeting Date:                 9/14/2021
Sponsor(s):                   Gardiner (45)
Type:                         Ordinance
Title:                        Zoning Reclassification Map No. 13-L at 5330-5338 W
                              Argyle St
Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                                       ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance, be amended by changing all ofthe RM-5,
Residential Multi-Unit District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 13-L in the
area bound by:

      North Long Street; the alley next north of and parallel to West Argyle Street; a line 225
      feet east of and parallel to North Long Street; and. West Argyle Street

to those of a RS-3, Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                           James M. Gardiner
                                                           Alderman, 45"" Ward




Common Address:
5330-38 West Argyle Street
